newsitem.title: JAPAN: European support for strong dlr hard on Japan - EPA.
newsitem.headline: European support for strong dlr hard on Japan - EPA.

text.p: Support from European nations for a strong dollar is making it difficult for Japan, Economic Planning Agency (EPA) Minister Taro Aso told a parliamentary committee on Friday.
Aso said the recent weakness of the yen was rather a singular strengthening of the dollar, adding that the greenback had risen substantially against the mark as well.
"And European nations are allowing for that. That makes it very difficult for Japan as the sole country," Aso said.
But Aso said the weakening of the Japanese currency will have a positive effect on production and corporate earnings in the near term.
"In the near term, the weak yen will lead to increased production and an improvement in earnings," he said.
